picks.headline: India's love affair with cash is fading: Why are more people swiping credit cards? - India Today
picks.angle: Using a credit card offers convenience, but it is essential to treat it like a digital version of cash, only spending what you can afford to pay back in full.
facts: India's love affair with cash is fading
More people are swiping credit cards
picks.avoid: Do not promote specific credit cards or suggest that credit cards are 'free money'.

picks.headline: Bank of India raises MCLR on overnight, one-month loans; revised rates effective December 1 - CNBC TV18
picks.angle: When lending rates like the MCLR increase, it often impacts the cost of your existing variable-rate loans, making it a good time to review your debt repayment plan.
facts: Bank of India raises MCLR on overnight, one-month loans
picks.avoid: Do not name the specific bank as a recommendation or make predictions about future interest rate trends.

picks.headline: Report shows personal borrowing for business grows faster than enterprise loan - CNBC TV18
picks.angle: Mixing personal and business finances can make it harder to track your progress; keep separate accounts to stay organized and build better money habits.
facts: Personal borrowing for business grows faster than enterprise loans
Report highlights trends in micro-entrepreneur debt
picks.avoid: Do not offer specific advice on how to structure a business or take out business loans.

general_picks.headline: Black Friday Sales
general_picks.story: Reliance Digitals Black Friday Sale: Enjoy Up to 50% Off on Smartphones, Laptops, TVs, Home Appliances and More - TheWire.in
general_picks.why_popular: Major retail platforms are running widespread sales on smartphones and home appliances with significant discounts.
general_picks.bridge: Just like a sale, the best way to handle your money is to have a list ready before you walk into the store to avoid impulse spending.
general_picks.hook: POV: You actually made a budget before shopping
facts: Major retailers are offering up to 50% off on electronics.
Sales events include deep discounts on popular smartphone and laptop models.
general_picks.avoid: Do not imply that people should use credit cards to take advantage of sales or suggest buying expensive items as an investment.

general_picks.headline: Daily Word Puzzle Games
general_picks.story: Today’s NYT Connections Hints And Answers For Saturday, November 28 - Forbes
general_picks.why_popular: People across the country are engaging with daily brain teasers like Connections, Wordle, and Quordle.
general_picks.bridge: Building financial health is like these daily games; it is all about consistency, keeping your streak alive, and showing up every day to make progress.
general_picks.hook: If consistency were a money habit
facts: People rely on daily hints to solve these trending puzzles.
Maintaining a long streak is a primary goal for many players.
general_picks.avoid: Do not compare money habits to gambling or suggest that financial success is a game of chance.
